# Vendored libsodium.js

`libsodium.js` and its license are from the immutable upstream `0.7.15` tag:

`https://github.com/jedisct1/libsodium.js/tree/0.7.15`

The browser build embeds its WebAssembly payload in the reviewed JavaScript
file. Verify both files with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` before updating or
packaging them.
